title: ArbiterIdRegistry
description: The registry of registries: every identifier scheme arbiter recognises, the regex that matches it, the file that owns its instances, and the mechanism that keeps it honest. Instances live in the machine-parsable table of docs/internal/SYSTEM/ID-REGISTRY.md. Enforced by scripts/check-id-registry.mjs (schema + prefix collisions + SSOT resolution) and scripts/check-ontology-wired.mjs (every row is wired to a real gate, tool and hook).

registryVersion.description: Semver of the registry contract itself. MAJOR changes when a column's meaning changes.

prefix.description: The literal token that opens an identifier, e.g. 'INV', 'MS', 'SRC'. '#' is the GitHub issue scheme. Two schemes may never share a prefix — that is the collision the gate exists to make impossible.

pattern.description: Anchored regex matching a full identifier of this scheme, e.g. '^INV-[0-9]{2,3}$'. Used by the gate to detect two schemes whose patterns can match the same string.

meaning.description: What one identifier of this scheme denotes. One sentence; the registry is an index, not documentation.

ssot.description: Repo-relative path of the file that owns the instances, or 'github' for schemes GitHub owns. The gate fails when a declared path does not exist.

gate.description: Repo-relative path of the check script that validates instances of this scheme, or 'n/a' with a reason in `note`. check-ontology-wired.mjs additionally asserts the script is registered in scripts/check-all.mjs.

track.description: Where the gate runs. 'self' = wired in scripts/check-all.mjs. 'target' = a Track-B emission wired in the generated src/templates/scripts/check-all.mjs.ejs (arbiter itself owns no instances of the scheme). 'both' = wired on both sides. check-ontology-wired.mjs picks which wiring it demands from this value, so a Track-B gate is never mistaken for an unwired one.

tool.description: The CLI surface that reads or writes instances, e.g. 'arbiter validate', 'arbiter graph build'. 'n/a' requires a reason in `note`.

hook.description: Repo-relative path of a .claude hook that enforces this scheme at agent-edit time, or 'n/a' with a reason in `note`.

status.description: active = fully wired. staged = an obligation with a deadline; `expires` is then mandatory and the gate fails once the date passes. retired = the prefix is burned and must never be reused.

graphNode.description: The NodeKind in src/graph/model.ts that carries instances of this scheme, when the provenance graph models it.

expires.description: Mandatory for status 'staged': the date by which the staged legs must be wired. A passed date is a gate failure, mirroring the dated-debt discipline of INV-31 and scripts/canon01-self-only.json.

note.description: Mandatory whenever gate, tool or hook is 'n/a', or when status is 'staged' or 'retired'. An 'n/a' without a reason is a blanket exemption, so the gate rejects it.
